columns.name: permaticker
columns.definition: Permanent Ticker Symbol — The permaticker is a unique and unchanging identifier issued by Sharadar for a security in the dataset. Distinct share classes of the same issuer receive distinct permatickers (for example primary and secondary common classes). This field is not included in other tables in order to maximise data scalability in those tables; join from those tables via ticker to TICKERS (filter on the table field as needed; e.g. SEP or SF1).

columns.name: ticker
columns.definition: Ticker Symbol — The ticker is a unique identifier for a security in the database. Where a company is delisted and the ticker subsequently recycled for use by a different company; we utilise that ticker for the currently active company and append a number to the ticker of the delisted company. The ACTIONS table provides a record of historical ticker changes.

columns.name: name
columns.definition: Issuer Name — The name of the security issuer.

columns.name: exchange
columns.definition: Stock Exchange — The exchange on which the security's primary listing is held. Examples are:

columns.name: isdelisted
columns.definition: Is Delisted? — Is the security delisted? [Y]es or [N]o.

columns.name: category
columns.definition: Issuer Category — The category of the issuer: Domestic; Canadian or ADR. This field is based on the filing category with the SEC. Domestic firms file form 10; ADRs file form 20 and Canadian firms file form 40.

columns.name: cusips
columns.definition: CUSIPs — A security identifier. Space delimited in the event of multiple identifiers.

columns.name: siccode
columns.definition: Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) Code — The Standard Industrial Classification (SIC) is a system for classifying industries by a four-digit code; as sourced from SEC filings. More on the SIC system here: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Standard_Industrial_Classification

columns.name: sicsector
columns.definition: SIC Sector — The SIC sector is based on the SIC code and the division tabled here: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Standard_Industrial_Classification

columns.name: sicindustry
columns.definition: SIC Industry — The SIC industry is based on the SIC code and the industry tabled here: https://www.sec.gov/info/edgar/siccodes.htm

columns.name: figi
columns.definition: Composite FIGI — The FIGI is a security identifier provided by openfigi.com. There are different types of FIGI; and this indicator represents the Composite FIGI type for US exchanges in the event that this is available in the openfigi.com API; or alternatively the non-composite FIGI type for US exchanges if only this is available. In the event of multiple FIGIs these are space delimited. This indicator is not available for all delisted stocks due to limitations in the openfigi.com API.

columns.name: famaindustry
columns.definition: Fama Industry — Industry classifications based on the SIC code and classifications by Fama and French here: http://mba.tuck.dartmouth.edu/pages/faculty/ken.french/Data_Library/det_48_ind_port.html

columns.name: sector
columns.definition: Sector — A sector classification based on SIC codes in a format which approximates to GICS.

columns.name: industry
columns.definition: Industry — An industry classification based on SIC codes in a format which approximates to GICS.

columns.name: scalemarketcap
columns.definition: Company Scale - Market Cap — This field is experimental and subject to change. It categorises the company according to it's maximum observed market cap as follows: 1 - Nano <$50m; 2 - Micro < $300m; 3 - Small < $2bn; 4 - Mid <$10bn; 5 - Large < $200bn; 6 - Mega >= $200bn

columns.name: scalerevenue
columns.definition: Company Scale - Revenue — This field is experimental and subject to change. It categorises the company according to it's maximum observed annual revenue as follows: 1 - Nano <$50m; 2 - Micro < $300m; 3 - Small < $2bn; 4 - Mid <$10bn; 5 - Large < $200bn; 6 - Mega >= $200bn

columns.name: relatedtickers
columns.definition: Related Tickers — Where related tickers have been identified this field is populated. Related tickers can include the prior ticker before a ticker change; and it includes tickers for alternative share classes.

columns.name: currency
columns.definition: Currency — The company functional reporting currency for the SF1 Fundamentals table or the currency for EOD prices in SEP and SFP.

columns.name: location
columns.definition: Location — The company location as registered with the Securities and Exchange Commission.

columns.name: firstadded
columns.definition: First Added Date — The date that the ticker was first added to coverage in the dataset.

columns.name: firstpricedate
columns.definition: First Price Date — The date of the first price observation for a given ticker. Can be used as a proxy for IPO date. Minimum value of 1986-01-01 for IPO's that occurred prior to this date. Note: this does not necessarily represent the first price date available in our datasets since our end of day price history currently starts in December 1997.

columns.name: lastpricedate
columns.definition: Last Price Date — The most recent price observation available.

columns.name: firstquarter
columns.definition: First Quarter — The first financial quarter available in the dataset.

columns.name: lastquarter
columns.definition: Last Quarter — The last financial quarter available in the dataset.

columns.name: secfilings
columns.definition: SEC Filings URL — The URL pointing to the SEC filings which also contains the Central Index Key (CIK).

columns.name: companysite
columns.definition: Company Website URL — The URL pointing to the company website.

columns.name: lastupdated
columns.definition: Last Updated Date — Last Updated represents the last date that this database entry was updated; which is useful to users when updating their local records.

columns.name: table
columns.definition: Table — The database table which the ticker is featured in. Examples are: SF1 or SEP.

columns.name: ticker
columns.definition: Ticker Symbol — The ticker is a unique identifier for a security in the database. Where a company is delisted and the ticker subsequently recycled for use by a different company; we utilise that ticker for the currently active company and append a number to the ticker of the delisted company. The ACTIONS table provides a record of historical ticker changes.

columns.name: date
columns.definition: Date — The date of the corporate action.

columns.name: action
columns.definition: Action — The available actions in this field are outlined in the INDICATORS table where the table field equals ACTIONTYPES.

columns.name: name
columns.definition: Issuer Name — The name of the issuer.

columns.name: value
columns.definition: Value — The available values in this field are outlined in the INDICATORS table where the table field equals ACTIONTYPES.

columns.name: contraticker
columns.definition: Contra Ticker Symbol — The contra ticker associated with the action; if applicable.

columns.name: contraname
columns.definition: Contra Issuer Name — The name of the contra issuer associated with the contra ticker.

columns.name: ticker
columns.definition: Ticker Symbol — The ticker is a unique identifier for a security in the database. Where a company is delisted and the ticker subsequently recycled for use by a different company; we utilise that ticker for the currently active company and append a number to the ticker of the delisted company. In the SP500 table; ticker and name always use the current Sharadar identifiers (history is rewired after ticker changes). Historical market symbols are recorded in the ACTIONS table (tickerchangefrom / tickerchangeto). Join to TICKERS on ticker (typically where table=SEP) to obtain permaticker and other metadata.

columns.name: date
columns.definition: Date — The action date (YYYY-MM-DD). For action=added and action=removed this is the effective index-membership date (not the announcement date). For action=historical this is the quarter-end snapshot date. For action=current this is our data refresh date. We do not distinguish between market open and close at present.

columns.name: action
columns.definition: Action — The type of S&P500 membership record. current: full set of present constituents; date is our data refresh date; contraticker is N/A. added: security entered the index; date is the effective membership date (not the announcement date); contraticker is the security removed in a paired swap when applicable. removed: security left the index; date is the effective membership date (not the announcement date); contraticker is the security added in a paired swap when applicable. historical: complete constituent snapshot on a calendar quarter-end (31 March; 30 June; 30 September; 31 December) from 1998-03-31 forward; one row per member on that date; contraticker is N/A.

columns.name: name
columns.definition: Issuer Name — The name of the issuer associated with ticker. As with ticker; names in the SP500 table reflect current labeling rather than the name as of the historical date.

columns.name: contraticker
columns.definition: Contra Ticker Symbol — The contra ticker is the opposing ticker entry when a membership swap is recorded. Where action=added it is the ticker removed in the same change; where action=removed it is the ticker added. N/A when there is no paired replacement (for example certain alternative share-class changes; see note).

columns.name: contraname
columns.definition: Contra Issuer Name — The name of the contra issuer corresponding to contraticker; or N/A when not applicable.

columns.name: note
columns.definition: Notes — Notes and additional information regarding additions to and removals from the S&P500. Examples include alternative share class added and alternative share class removed without replacement.

columns.name: ticker
columns.definition: Ticker Symbol — The ticker is a unique identifier for a security in the database. Where a company is delisted and the ticker subsequently recycled for use by a different company; we utilise that ticker for the currently active company and append a number to the ticker of the delisted company. The ACTIONS table provides a record of historical ticker changes.

columns.name: as_of
columns.definition: Price Date — The trade date of the most recent price and volume available.

columns.name: price
columns.definition: Price — The closing stock price on the date.

columns.name: beta1y
columns.definition: Beta - 1 Year Daily — The beta of the stock over 1 year relative to the market calculated using daily adjusted closing price of the stock (as adjusted for stock splits; dividends and spinoffs) relative to total returns of the market as represented by the adjusted closing prices of the SPY S&P500 ETF. Recalculated and updated on a weekly basis.

columns.name: beta5y
columns.definition: Beta - 5 Year Monthly — The beta of the stock over 5 years relative to the market calculated using monthly adjusted closing price of the stock (as adjusted for stock splits; dividends and spinoffs) relative to total returns of the market as represented by the adjusted closing prices of the SPY S&P500 ETF. Recalculated and updated on a weekly basis.

columns.name: ma50d
columns.definition: Price Moving Average - 50 Day — The 50 day moving average closing price as adjusted for stock splits and stock dividends; but not cash dividends or spinoffs. Not available if the stock has been trading less than 50 days.

columns.name: ma200d
columns.definition: Price Moving Average - 200 Day — The 200 day moving average closing price as adjusted for stock splits and stock dividends; but not cash dividends or spinoffs. Not available if the stock has been trading less than 200 days.

columns.name: high52w
columns.definition: High Price - 52 Week — The highest price over the last 52 weeks as adjusted for stock splits and stock dividends; but not cash dividends or spinoffs.

columns.name: low52w
columns.definition: Low Price - 52 Week — The lowest price over the last 52 weeks as adjusted for stock splits and stock dividends; but not cash dividends or spinoffs.

columns.name: return1y
columns.definition: Total Return - 1 Year — The total return over 1 year calculated using the closing price as adjusted for stock splits and stock dividends; but not cash dividends or spinoffs. Not available if the stock has been trading for less than 1 year.

columns.name: return5y
columns.definition: Total Return - 5 Year — The total return over 5 years calculated using the closing price as adjusted for stock splits and stock dividends; but not cash dividends or spinoffs. Not available if the stock has been trading for less than 5 years.

columns.name: returnytd
columns.definition: Total Return - Year to Date — The total return for the year to date calculated using the closing price as adjusted for stock splits and stock dividends; but not cash dividends or spinoffs.

columns.name: volume
columns.definition: Volume — The daily traded volume across all exchanges; adjusted for stock splits and stock dividends. Not adjusted for cash dividends or spinoffs. Includes opening and closing cross volumes if applicable.

columns.name: volumeavg1m
columns.definition: Volume Average - 1 Month — The daily average traded volume over 1 month across all exchanges; adjusted for stock splits and stock dividends. Not adjusted for cash dividends or spinoffs. Includes opening and closing cross volumes if applicable.

columns.name: volumeavg3m
columns.definition: Volume Average - 3 Month — The daily average traded volume over 3 months across all exchanges; adjusted for stock splits and stock dividends. Not adjusted for cash dividends or spinoffs. Includes opening and closing cross volumes if applicable.

columns.name: dividendyieldtrailing
columns.definition: Dividend Yield - Trailing — The trailing dividend yield; calculated by summing regular and special cash dividend payments in the last year; dividing by the stock price and multiplying by 100.

columns.name: dividendyieldforward
columns.definition: Dividend Yield - Forward — The forward dividend yield; calculated by annualising the last regular cash dividend payment; dividing by the stock price and multiplying by 100.

columns.name: high5y
columns.definition: High Price - 5 Year — The highest price over the last 5 years as adjusted for stock splits and stock dividends; but not cash dividends or spinoffs.

columns.name: low5y
columns.definition: Low Price - 5 Year — The lowest price over the last 5 years weeks as adjusted for stock splits and stock dividends; but not cash dividends or spinoffs.

metrics.notes: stores 19 of the vendor's 22 METRICS fields (as_of = vendor `date` renamed; dropped lastupdated, ma200w, ma50w)

columns.name: ticker
columns.definition: Ticker Symbol — [Entity] The ticker is a unique identifier for a security in the database. Where a company is delisted and the ticker subsequently recycled for use by a different company; we utilise that ticker for the currently active company and append a number to the ticker of the delisted company. The ACTIONS table provides a record of historical ticker changes.

columns.name: dimension
columns.definition: Dimension — [Entity] The dimension field allows you to take different dimensional views of data over time. ARQ: Quarterly; excluding restatements; MRQ: Quarterly; including restatements; ARY: annual; excluding restatements; MRY: annual; including restatements; ART: trailing-twelve-months; excluding restatements; MRT: trailing-twelve-months; including restatements.

columns.name: date
columns.definition: this repo — as-of/observation date key for point-in-time lookups (filing date for AR*, report-key date for MR*)

columns.name: reportperiod
columns.definition: Report Period — [Entity] The Report Period represents the end date of the fiscal period.

columns.name: fiscalperiod
columns.definition: Fiscal Period — The fiscal period of the report expressed as follows: 2024-Q2; 2024-Q3; 2024-FY etc. Note that companies can have different fiscal periods for the report period due to different year end dates.

columns.name: calendardate
columns.definition: Calendar Date — [Entity] The Calendar Date represents the normalized [ReportPeriod]. This provides a common date to query for which is necessary due to irregularity in report periods across companies. For example; if the report period is 2015-09-26; the calendar date will be 2015-09-30 for quarterly and trailing-twelve-month dimensions (ARQ;MRQ;ART;MRT); and 2015-12-31 for annual dimensions (ARY;MRY). We also employ offsets in order to maximise comparability of the period across companies. For example consider two companies: one with a quarter ending on 2018-07-24; and the other with a quarter ending on 2018-06-28. A naive normalization process would assign these to differing calendar quarters of 2018-09-30 and 2018-06-30 respectively. However; we assign these both to the 2018-06-30 calendar quarter because this maximises the overlap in the report periods in question and therefore the comparability of this period.

columns.name: lastupdated
columns.definition: Last Updated Date — [Entity] Last Updated represents the last date that this database entry was updated; which is useful to users when updating their local records.

columns.name: revenue
columns.definition: Revenues — [Income Statement] The amount of Revenue recognised from goods sold; services rendered; insurance premiums; or other activities that constitute an earning process. Interest income for financial institutions is reported net of interest expense and provision for credit losses. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: netinc
columns.definition: Net Income — [Income Statement] The portion of profit or loss for the period; net of income taxes; which is attributable to the parent after the deduction of [NetIncNCI] from [ConsolInc]; and before the deduction of [PrefDivIS].

columns.name: netinccmn
columns.definition: Net Income Common Stock — [Income Statement] The amount of net income (loss) for the period due to common shareholders. Typically differs from [NetInc] to the parent entity due to the deduction of [PrefDivIS].

columns.name: assets
columns.definition: Total Assets — [Balance Sheet] Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all assets that are recognized. Major components are [CashnEq]; [Investments];[Intangibles]; [PPNENet];[TaxAssets] and [Receivables].

columns.name: liabilities
columns.definition: Total Liabilities — [Balance Sheet] Sum of the carrying amounts as of the balance sheet date of all liabilities that are recognized. Principal components are [Debt]; [DeferredRev]; [Payables];[Deposits]; and [TaxLiabilities].

columns.name: equity
columns.definition: Shareholders Equity Attributable to Parent — [Balance Sheet] A principal component of the balance sheet; in addition to [Liabilities] and [Assets]; that represents the total of all stockholders' equity (deficit) items; net of receivables from officers; directors; owners; and affiliates of the entity which are attributable to the parent.

columns.name: cashneq
columns.definition: Cash and Equivalents — [Balance Sheet] A component of [Assets] representing the amount of currency on hand as well as demand deposits with banks or financial institutions. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: ncfo
columns.definition: Net Cash Flow from Operations — [Cash Flow Statement] A component of [NCF] representing the amount of cash inflow (outflow) from operating activities; from continuing and discontinued operations.

columns.name: capex
columns.definition: Capital Expenditure — [Cash Flow Statement] A component of [NCFI] representing the net cash inflow (outflow) associated with the acquisition & disposal of long-lived; physical & intangible assets that are used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and are not intended for resale. Includes cash inflows/outflows to pay for construction of self-constructed assets & software. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: fcf
columns.definition: Free Cash Flow — [Metrics] Free Cash Flow is a measure of financial performance calculated as [NCFO] minus [CapEx].

columns.name: marketcap
columns.definition: Market Capitalization — [Metrics] Represents the product of [SharesBas]; [Price] and [ShareFactor].

columns.name: ev
columns.definition: Enterprise Value — [Metrics] Enterprise value is a measure of the value of a business as a whole; calculated as [MarketCap] plus [DebtUSD] minus [CashnEqUSD].

columns.name: pe
columns.definition: Price Earnings (Damodaran Method) — [Metrics] Measures the ratio between [MarketCap] and [NetIncCmnUSD]

columns.name: pb
columns.definition: Price to Book Value — [Metrics] Measures the ratio between [MarketCap] and [EquityUSD].

columns.name: ps
columns.definition: Price Sales (Damodaran Method) — [Metrics] Measures the ratio between [MarketCap] and [RevenueUSD].

columns.name: price
columns.definition: Share Price (Adjusted Close) — [Entity] The price per common share adjusted for stock splits but not adjusted for dividends; used in the computation of [PE1]; [PS1]; [DivYield] and [SPS].

columns.name: eps
columns.definition: Earnings per Basic Share — [Income Statement] Earnings per share as calculated and reported by the company. Approximates to the amount of [NetIncCmn] for the period per each [SharesWA] after adjusting for [ShareFactor].

columns.name: dps
columns.definition: Dividends per Basic Common Share — [Income Statement] Aggregate dividends declared during the period for each split-adjusted share of common stock outstanding. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: divyield
columns.definition: Dividend Yield — [Metrics] Dividend Yield measures the ratio between a company's trailing twelve month [DPS] and its close [Price]; by summing dividends by ExDate; provided in the SHARADAR/ACTIONS table; in the twelve months leading up to the date in the [DateKey] indicator.  Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: roe
columns.definition: Return on Average Equity — [Metrics] Return on equity measures a corporation's profitability by calculating the amount of [NetIncCmn] returned as a percentage of [EquityAvg].

columns.name: roa
columns.definition: Return on Average Assets — [Metrics] Return on assets measures how profitable a company is [NetIncCmn] relative to its total assets [AssetsAvg].

columns.name: roic
columns.definition: Return on Invested Capital — [Metrics] Return on Invested Capital is a ratio estimated by dividing [EBIT] by [InvCapAvg]. [InvCap] is calculated as: [Debt] plus [Assets] minus [Intangibles] minus [CashnEq] minus [LiabilitiesC]. Please note this calculation method is subject to change.

columns.name: grossmargin
columns.definition: Gross Margin — [Metrics] Gross Margin measures the ratio between a company's [GP] and [Revenue].

columns.name: netmargin
columns.definition: Profit Margin — [Metrics] Measures the ratio between a company's [NetIncCmn] and [Revenue].

columns.name: ebitda
columns.definition: Earnings Before Interest Taxes & Depreciation Amortization (EBITDA) — [Metrics] EBITDA is a non-GAAP accounting metric that is widely used when assessing the performance of companies; calculated by adding [DepAmor] back to [EBIT].

columns.name: shareswa
columns.definition: Weighted Average Shares — [Income Statement] The weighted average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used by the company to calculate [EPS]; determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

columns.name: shareswadil
columns.definition: Weighted Average Shares Diluted — [Income Statement] The weighted average number of shares or units issued and outstanding that are used by the company to calculate [EPSDil]; determined based on the timing of issuance of shares or units in the period.

columns.name: currentratio
columns.definition: Current Ratio — [Metrics] The ratio between [AssetsC] and [LiabilitiesC]; for companies that operate a classified balance sheet.

columns.name: de
columns.definition: Debt to Equity Ratio — [Metrics] Measures the ratio between [Liabilities] and [Equity].

columns.name: data
columns.definition: this repo — zlib-compressed JSON of the FULL vendor row (all 105 indicator fields beyond the 7 key/date fields)

columns.name: ticker
columns.definition: Ticker Symbol — The ticker is a unique identifier for a security in the database. Where a company is delisted and the ticker subsequently recycled for use by a different company; we utilise that ticker for the currently active company and append a number to the ticker of the delisted company. The ACTIONS table provides a record of historical ticker changes.

columns.name: date
columns.definition: Price Date — The trade date of the price observations.

columns.name: open
columns.definition: Open Price - Split Adjusted — The official exchange opening price; adjusted for stock splits and stock dividends. Not adjusted for cash dividends or spinoffs.

columns.name: high
columns.definition: High Price - Split Adjusted — The high share price; adjusted for stock splits and stock dividends. Not adjusted for cash dividends or spinoffs.

columns.name: low
columns.definition: Low Price - Split Adjusted — The low share price; adjusted for stock splits and stock dividends. Not adjusted for cash dividends or spinoffs.

columns.name: close
columns.definition: Close Price - Split Adjusted — The official exchange close price; adjusted for stock splits and stock dividends. Not adjusted for cash dividends or spinoffs.

columns.name: volume
columns.definition: Volume - Split Adjusted — The daily traded volume across all exchanges; adjusted for stock splits and stock dividends. Not adjusted for cash dividends or spinoffs. Includes opening and closing cross volumes if applicable.

columns.name: adjustment
columns.definition: this repo — total-return factor = closeadj/closeunadj (split+dividend chain, normalized to 1.0 at latest quote)

prices.notes: from the SEP/SFP bulk price columns; closeadj/closeunadj collapsed into `adjustment`; stored close = closeunadj (as-traded), OHLC as-traded (vendor OHLC are split-adjusted)

columns.name: accoci
columns.definition: Accumulated Other Comprehensive Income — [Balance Sheet] A component of [Equity] representing the accumulated change in equity from transactions and other events and circumstances from non-owner sources; net of tax effect; at period end. Includes foreign currency translation items; certain pension adjustments; unrealized gains and losses on certain investments in debt and equity securities. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: assetsavg
columns.definition: Average Assets — [Metrics] Average asset value for the period used in calculation of [ROE] and [ROA]; derived from [Assets].

columns.name: assetsc
columns.definition: Current Assets — [Balance Sheet] The current portion of [Assets]; reported if a company operates a classified balance sheet that segments current and non-current assets.

columns.name: assetsnc
columns.definition: Assets Non-Current — [Balance Sheet] Amount of non-current assets; for companies that operate a classified balance sheet. Calculated as the different between Total Assets [Assets] and Current Assets [AssetsC].

columns.name: assetturnover
columns.definition: Asset Turnover — [Metrics] Asset turnover is a measure of a firms operating efficiency; calculated by dividing [Revenue] by [AssetsAVG]. Often a component of DuPont ROE analysis.

columns.name: bvps
columns.definition: Book Value per Share — [Metrics] Measures the ratio between [Equity] and [SharesWA] as adjusted by [ShareFactor].

columns.name: cashnequsd
columns.definition: Cash and Equivalents (USD) — [Balance Sheet] [CashnEq] in USD; converted by [FXUSD]. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: consolinc
columns.definition: Consolidated Income — [Income Statement] The portion of profit or loss for the period; net of income taxes; which is attributable to the consolidated entity; before the deduction of [NetIncNCI].

columns.name: cor
columns.definition: Cost of Revenue — [Income Statement] The aggregate cost of goods produced and sold and services rendered during the reporting period. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: datekey
columns.definition: Date Key — [Entity] The Date Key represents the SEC filing date for AR dimensions (ARQ;ART;ARY); and the [REPORTPERIOD] for MR dimensions (MRQ;MRT;MRY). In addition; this is the observation date used for [Price] based data such as [MarketCap]; [Price] and [PE].

columns.name: debt
columns.definition: Total Debt — [Balance Sheet] A component of [Liabilities] representing the total amount of current and non-current debt owed. Includes secured and unsecured bonds issued; commercial paper; notes payable; credit facilities; lines of credit; capital lease obligations; operating lease obligations; and convertible notes. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: debtc
columns.definition: Debt Current — [Balance Sheet] The current portion of [Debt]; reported if the company operates a classified balance sheet that segments current and non-current liabilities. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: debtnc
columns.definition: Debt Non-Current — [Balance Sheet] The non-current portion of [Debt] reported if the company operates a classified balance sheet that segments current and non-current liabilities. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: debtusd
columns.definition: Total Debt (USD) — [Balance Sheet] [Debt] in USD; converted by [FXUSD]. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: deferredrev
columns.definition: Deferred Revenue — [Balance Sheet] A component of [Liabilities] representing the carrying amount of consideration received or receivable on potential earnings that were not recognized as revenue; including sales; license fees; and royalties; but excluding interest income. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: depamor
columns.definition: Depreciation Amortization & Accretion — [Cash Flow Statement] A component of operating cash flow representing the aggregate net amount of depreciation; amortization; and accretion recognized during an accounting period. As a non-cash item; the net amount is added back to net income when calculating cash provided by or used in operations using the indirect method. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: deposits
columns.definition: Deposit Liabilities — [Balance Sheet] A component of [Liabilities] representing the total of all deposit liabilities held; including foreign and domestic; interest and noninterest bearing. May include demand deposits; saving deposits; Negotiable Order of Withdrawal and time deposits among others. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: ebit
columns.definition: Earning Before Interest & Taxes (EBIT) — [Income Statement] Earnings Before Interest and Tax is calculated by adding [TaxExp] and [IntExp] back to [NetInc].

columns.name: ebitdamargin
columns.definition: EBITDA Margin — [Metrics] Measures the ratio between a company's [EBITDA] and [Revenue].

columns.name: ebitdausd
columns.definition: Earnings Before Interest Taxes & Depreciation Amortization (USD) — [Metrics] [EBITDA] in USD; converted by [FXUSD].

columns.name: ebitusd
columns.definition: Earning Before Interest & Taxes (USD) — [Income Statement] [EBIT] in USD; converted by [FXUSD].

columns.name: ebt
columns.definition: Earnings before Tax — [Metrics] Earnings Before Tax is calculated by adding [TaxExp] back to [NetInc].

columns.name: epsdil
columns.definition: Earnings per Diluted Share — [Income Statement] Earnings per diluted share as calculated and reported by the company. Approximates to the amount of [NetIncCmn] for the period per each [SharesWADil] after adjusting for [ShareFactor]..

columns.name: epsusd
columns.definition: Earnings per Basic Share (USD) — [Income Statement] [EPS] in USD; converted by [FXUSD].

columns.name: equityavg
columns.definition: Average Equity — [Metrics] Average equity value for the period used in calculation of [ROE]; derived from [Equity].

columns.name: equityusd
columns.definition: Shareholders Equity (USD) — [Balance Sheet] [Equity] in USD; converted by [FXUSD].

columns.name: evebit
columns.definition: Enterprise Value over EBIT — [Metrics] Measures the ratio between [EV] and [EBITUSD].

columns.name: evebitda
columns.definition: Enterprise Value over EBITDA — [Metrics] Measures the ratio between [EV] and [EBITDAUSD].

columns.name: fcfps
columns.definition: Free Cash Flow per Share — [Metrics] Free Cash Flow per Share is a valuation metric calculated by dividing [FCF] by [SharesWA] and [ShareFactor].

columns.name: fxusd
columns.definition: Foreign Currency to USD Exchange Rate — [Metrics] The exchange rate used for the conversion of foreign currency to USD for non-US companies that do not report in USD.

columns.name: gp
columns.definition: Gross Profit — [Income Statement] Aggregate revenue [Revenue] less cost of revenue [CoR] directly attributable to the revenue generation activity.

columns.name: intangibles
columns.definition: Goodwill and Intangible Assets — [Balance Sheet] A component of [Assets] representing the carrying amounts of all intangible assets and goodwill as of the balance sheet date; net of accumulated amortization and impairment charges. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: intexp
columns.definition: Interest Expense — [Income Statement] Amount of the cost of borrowed funds accounted for as interest expense. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: invcap
columns.definition: Invested Capital — [Metrics] Invested capital is an input into the calculation of [ROIC]; and is calculated as: [Debt] plus [Assets] minus [Intangibles] minus [CashnEq] minus [LiabilitiesC]. Please note this calculation method is subject to change.

columns.name: invcapavg
columns.definition: Invested Capital Average — [Metrics] Average invested capital value for the period used in the calculation of [ROIC]; and derived from [InvCap]. Invested capital is an input into the calculation of [ROIC]; and is calculated as: [Debt] plus [Assets] minus [Intangibles] minus [CashnEq] minus [LiabilitiesC]. Please note this calculation method is subject to change.

columns.name: inventory
columns.definition: Inventory — [Balance Sheet] A component of [Assets] representing the amount after valuation and reserves of inventory expected to be sold; or consumed within one year or operating cycle; if longer. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: investments
columns.definition: Investments — [Balance Sheet] A component of [Assets] representing the total amount of marketable and non-marketable securties; loans receivable; equity-method investments; and other invested assets. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: investmentsc
columns.definition: Investments Current — [Balance Sheet] The current portion of [Investments]; reported if the company operates a classified balance sheet that segments current and non-current assets. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: investmentsnc
columns.definition: Investments Non-Current — [Balance Sheet] The non-current portion of [Investments]; reported if the company operates a classified balance sheet that segments current and non-current assets. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: liabilitiesc
columns.definition: Current Liabilities — [Balance Sheet] The current portion of [Liabilities]; reported if the company operates a classified balance sheet that segments current and non-current liabilities.

columns.name: liabilitiesnc
columns.definition: Liabilities Non-Current — [Balance Sheet] The non-current portion of [Liabilities]; reported if the company operates a classified balance sheet that segments current and non-current liabilities.

columns.name: ncf
columns.definition: Net Cash Flow / Change in Cash & Cash Equivalents — [Cash Flow Statement] Principal component of the cash flow statement representing the amount of increase (decrease) in cash and cash equivalents. Includes [NCFO]; investing [NCFI] and financing [NCFF] for continuing and discontinued operations; and the effect of exchange rate changes on cash [NCFX].

columns.name: ncfbus
columns.definition: Net Cash Flow - Business Acquisitions and Disposals — [Cash Flow Statement] A component of [NCFI] representing the net cash inflow (outflow) associated with the acquisition & disposal of businesses; joint-ventures; affiliates; and other named investments. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: ncfcommon
columns.definition: Issuance (Purchase) of Equity Shares — [Cash Flow Statement] A component of [NCFF] representing the net cash inflow (outflow) from common equity changes. Includes additional capital contributions from share issuances and exercise of stock options; and outflow from share repurchases.  Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: ncfdebt
columns.definition: Issuance (Repayment) of Debt Securities  — [Cash Flow Statement] A component of [NCFF] representing the net cash inflow (outflow) from issuance (repayment) of debt securities. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: ncfdiv
columns.definition: Payment of Dividends & Other Cash Distributions    — [Cash Flow Statement] A component of [NCFF] representing dividends and dividend equivalents paid on common stock and restricted stock units. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: ncff
columns.definition: Net Cash Flow from Financing — [Cash Flow Statement] A component of [NCF] representing the amount of cash inflow (outflow) from financing activities; from continuing and discontinued operations. Principal components of financing cash flow are: issuance (purchase) of equity shares; issuance (repayment) of debt securities; and payment of dividends & other cash distributions. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: ncfi
columns.definition: Net Cash Flow from Investing — [Cash Flow Statement] A component of [NCF] representing the amount of cash inflow (outflow) from investing activities; from continuing and discontinued operations. Principal components of investing cash flow are: capital (expenditure) disposal of equipment [CapEx]; business (acquisitions) disposition [NCFBus] and investment (acquisition) disposal [NCFInv]. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: ncfinv
columns.definition: Net Cash Flow - Investment Acquisitions and Disposals — [Cash Flow Statement] A component of [NCFI] representing the net cash inflow (outflow) associated with the acquisition & disposal of investments; including marketable securities and loan originations. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: ncfx
columns.definition: Effect of Exchange Rate Changes on Cash  — [Cash Flow Statement] A component of Net Cash Flow [NCF] representing the amount of increase (decrease) from the effect of exchange rate changes on cash and cash equivalent balances held in foreign currencies. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: netinccmnusd
columns.definition: Net Income Common Stock (USD) — [Income Statement] [NetIncCmn] in USD; converted by [FXUSD].

columns.name: netincdis
columns.definition: Net Loss Income from Discontinued Operations — [Income Statement] Amount of loss (income) from a disposal group; net of income tax; reported as a separate component of income. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: netincnci
columns.definition: Net Income to Non-Controlling Interests — [Income Statement] The portion of income which is attributable to non-controlling interest shareholders; subtracted from [ConsolInc] in order to obtain [NetInc]. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: opex
columns.definition: Operating Expenses — [Income Statement] Operating expenses represent the total expenditure on [SGnA]; [RnD] and other operating expense items; it excludes [CoR].

columns.name: opinc
columns.definition: Operating Income — [Income Statement] Operating income is a measure of financial performance before the deduction of [IntExp]; [TaxExp] and other Non-Operating items. It is calculated as [GP] minus [OpEx].

columns.name: payables
columns.definition: Trade and Non-Trade Payables — [Balance Sheet] A component of [Liabilities] representing trade and non-trade payables. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: payoutratio
columns.definition: Payout Ratio — [Metrics] The percentage of earnings paid as dividends to common stockholders. Calculated by dividing [DPS] by [EPSUSD].

columns.name: pe1
columns.definition: Price to Earnings Ratio — [Metrics] An alternative to [PE] representing the ratio between [Price] and [EPSUSD].

columns.name: ppnenet
columns.definition: Property Plant & Equipment Net — [Balance Sheet] A component of [Assets] representing the amount after accumulated depreciation; depletion and amortization of physical assets used in the normal conduct of business to produce goods and services and not intended for resale. Includes Operating Right of Use Assets. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: prefdivis
columns.definition: Preferred Dividends Income Statement Impact — [Income Statement] Income statement item reflecting dividend payments to preferred stockholders. Subtracted from Net Income to Parent [NetInc] to obtain Net Income to Common Stockholders [NetIncCmn]. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: ps1
columns.definition: Price to Sales Ratio — [Metrics] An alternative calculation method to [PS]; that measures the ratio between a company's [Price] and it's [SPS].

columns.name: receivables
columns.definition: Trade and Non-Trade Receivables — [Balance Sheet] A component of [Assets] representing trade and non-trade receivables. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: retearn
columns.definition: Accumulated Retained Earnings (Deficit) — [Balance Sheet] A component of [Equity] representing the cumulative amount of the entities undistributed earnings or deficit. May only be reported annually by certain companies; rather than quarterly.

columns.name: revenueusd
columns.definition: Revenues (USD) — [Income Statement] [Revenue] in USD; converted by [FXUSD]. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: rnd
columns.definition: Research and Development Expense — [Income Statement] A component of [OpEx] representing the aggregate costs incurred in a planned search or critical investigation aimed at discovery of new knowledge with the hope that such knowledge will be useful in developing a new product or service. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: ros
columns.definition: Return on Sales — [Metrics] Return on Sales is a ratio to evaluate a company's operational efficiency; calculated by dividing [EBIT] by [Revenue]. ROS is often a component of DuPont ROE analysis.

columns.name: sbcomp
columns.definition: Share Based Compensation — [Cash Flow Statement] A component of [NCFO] representing the total amount of noncash; equity-based employee remuneration. This may include the value of stock or unit options; amortization of restricted stock or units; and adjustment for officers' compensation. As noncash; this element is an add back when calculating net cash generated by operating activities using the indirect method.

columns.name: sgna
columns.definition: Selling General and Administrative Expense — [Income Statement] A component of [OpEx] representing the aggregate total costs related to selling a firm's product and services; as well as all other general and administrative expenses. Direct selling expenses (for example; credit; warranty; and advertising) are expenses that can be directly linked to the sale of specific products. Indirect selling expenses are expenses that cannot be directly linked to the sale of specific products; for example telephone expenses; Internet; and postal charges. General and administrative expenses include salaries of non-sales personnel; rent; utilities; communication; etc. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: sharefactor
columns.definition: Share Factor — [Entity] Share factor is a multiplicand in the calculation of [MarketCap] and is used to adjust for: American Depository Receipts (ADRs) that represent more or less than 1 underlying share; and; companies which have different earnings share for different share classes (eg Berkshire Hathaway - BRK.B).

columns.name: sharesbas
columns.definition: Shares (Basic) — [Entity] The number of shares or other units outstanding of the entity's capital or common stock or other ownership interests; as stated on the cover of related periodic report (10-K/10-Q); after adjustment for stock splits.

columns.name: sps
columns.definition: Sales per Share — [Metrics] Sales per Share measures the ratio between [RevenueUSD] and [SharesWA] as adjusted by [ShareFactor].

columns.name: tangibles
columns.definition: Tangible Asset Value — [Metrics] The value of tangibles assets calculated as the difference between [Assets] and [Intangibles].

columns.name: taxassets
columns.definition: Tax Assets — [Balance Sheet] A component of [Assets] representing tax assets and receivables. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: taxexp
columns.definition: Income Tax Expense — [Income Statement] Amount of current income tax expense (benefit) and deferred income tax expense (benefit) pertaining to continuing operations. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: taxliabilities
columns.definition: Tax Liabilities — [Balance Sheet] A component of [Liabilities] representing outstanding tax liabilities. Where this item is not contained on the company consolidated financial statements and cannot otherwise be imputed the value of 0 is used.

columns.name: tbvps
columns.definition: Tangible Assets Book Value per Share — [Metrics] Measures the ratio between [Tangibles] and [SharesWA] as adjusted by [ShareFactor].

columns.name: workingcapital
columns.definition: Working Capital — [Metrics] Working capital measures the difference between [AssetsC] and [LiabilitiesC].
